reviews.title: Great value and surprisingly great quality
reviews.comment: After a month of use I am ready to give it a simple review. As a lifelong gamer with eyes sensitive to ghosting  I'm usually a harsh critic when it comes to most screens. So when I say that this discount off-brand monitor blew my mind please know that this isn't an exaggeration. Yes I may have gotten lucky, but regardless the model sent to me is surpassing every expectation. PROS: Speed - The screen seems most comfortable at either 120hz or 200hz. It felt a little off at 165 but that may be my own eyes. Setting overdrive to Off or Normal seems to give the best results along with the high refresh. Color - HDR is pretty damn good on this thing. Not as good as some expensive oleds would be but still surprisingly good. Otherwise set the screen to Movie for the brightest and most vivid SDR colors. Cons: MPRT felt weird to me. Reverse ghosting weird. So just leave that off. Wasn't too big a fan of the VRR but it definitely works fine. Just kinda mutes the colors a notch and feels like strobbing but that is probably just my eyes. My friends and wife have all said it looks great with VRR to them. I just keep it set to 200hz Conclusion: For the money you cant beat this screen. Ive been using it with games both on my PC and also streaming with GeForce Now (which seems to lock to 120hz on it) and it works great either way.

reviews.title: Good for the value, but tilts backward
reviews.comment: The monitor itself it nice for the price, but the stand is not. The attachment isn't very secure, causing the monitor to tilt backward, making it not ideal if you like a raised monitor. I'm considering returning it for that reason alone. But we'll see how it holds up. Overall, the picture is nice, my games look good on it. I'm just disappointed with the mount and adjustability.
